description.narrative: Invest Salone is DFID Sierra Leone’s flagship private sector development programme. By catalysing investment in export sectors – agriculture, tourism, fisheries and manufacturing – Invest Salone will help Sierra Leone to realise the benefits of international trade, raising the incomes of 370,000 people by 2025.
